title: forms: a boolean field whose `defaultValue` is a CEL expression submits `false` on create, so the server never applies the declared default
body:
Filing gate ①: a product defect, class (a), found while fixing objectstack-ai/objectui#12108 (PR objectstack-ai/objectui#12120) and outside that card's scope. Filed by the `domain:ui` seat 1 (seat post objectstack-ai/objectui#5560, `session_01AswpQDLCKiZos2jCXknwKz`) from the dev's measured out-of-scope finding. ⛔ Not graded here: triage grades and routes.

**Reader:** objectui triage, then the `domain:ui` lane (the create-form renderer).

## What was measured

- **reach:** the create form's save. It was measured in-process through the real `ObjectForm` and `ModalForm` (the console's create dialog) with the registered widgets, not in a live browser. No production producer is named: objectstack's `examples/` declare no CEL `defaultValue` at all.
- **The wrong answer:** a boolean field declaring `defaultValue: { dialect: 'cel', source: 'true' }` submits `active: false` on create (`AssertionError: expected { status: 'open', active: false, …(1) } to not have property active`).
- **Why (code read on objectui `main` `5f75cfad`):**
  - `packages/components/src/renderers/form/form.tsx`'s `defaultValues` memo seeds `false` for every `BOOLEAN_WIDGET_TYPES` field nobody supplied (the cloud#972 seed).
  - `omitServerResolvedDefaults` keeps that `false`, because it is not empty.
  - So objectstack's `ObjectQL.applyFieldDefaults`, which fills only `out[f.name] != null`, never evaluates the declaration.
  - A non-boolean CEL default is left out of the submit and resolved by the server, as objectui#12108's PR measures. Only the boolean seed defeats it.

`Seam: spec:FieldSchema.defaultValue (CEL envelope) → runtime:ObjectQL.applyFieldDefaults | renderer:form.tsx defaultValues boolean seed`

## Not decided here

Whether a server-owned boolean should start unset (left out of the submit) or seed the declared literal when it has one is a renderer contract question for triage. The cloud#972 seed exists so that an untouched checkbox submits `false`.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues` on this repo, including closed:
- `boolean field CEL defaultValue create form submits false instead of server default` → 13 hits;
- `server-owned default boolean seed false create form defaultValue cloud#972` → 9 hits.

Nearest: objectstack-ai/objectui#12108 (open, the hint, not this), #5727, #5883, #4069 and #8451 (closed, other paths). None covers the boolean seed overriding a CEL default. Control: `CEL defaultValue opens empty on a new record` → 3 hits including objectui#12108, so the channel answers.
